title: Le Petit Prince
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
overview: A pilot stranded in the Sahara meets a little prince from a distant asteroid. As the prince shares stories of his travels, a rose, a fox, and big questions about friendship and growing up, this poetic adventure invites readers to look beyond appearances and notice the things that truly matter.

title: The Secret Garden
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
overview: A lonely girl discovers a hidden garden behind a locked gate and, with her cousin and a friendly robin, brings it back to life, learning about nature, healing and growing up.

title: A Wrinkle in Time
author: Madeleine L'Engle
overview: Meg Murry, her little brother Charles Wallace and their friend Calvin travel across space and time to rescue Meg's father. A story of courage, family and the battle between light and darkness.

title: The Story of Science
author: Joy Hakim
overview: From ancient astronomers to modern physics, Joy Hakim tells the story of science as an adventure of curiosity, experiments and great ideas.

title: A Little History of the World
author: E. H. Gombrich
overview: E. H. Gombrich tells the story of mankind in short, lively chapters, from cave dwellers to the modern age, written for young readers with warmth and wit.

title: Around the World in Eighty Days
author: Jules Verne
overview: Phileas Fogg bets his entire fortune that he can circle the globe in eighty days. Trains, steamers and even an elephant carry readers on a breathless race against the clock.

title: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
author: Mark Twain
overview: Adventures of a young boy named Tom Sawyer growing up along the Mississippi River, including whitewashing the fence, runaway steamboat journeys and his lifelong friendship with Huck Finn.

title: الحوت الأزرق
author: تراث شعبي
overview: A young boy sets sail across the sea with his beloved whale to return him to the deep waters, learning about friendship and courage along the way.

title: The Magic School Bus: Lost in the Solar System
author: Joanna Cole
overview: Ms. Frizzle's class boards the magic school bus and blasts off for the outer planets, where the bus transforms into a spaceship, a comet and more.

title: The Silk Road
author: Derek Thompson
overview: Follow the ancient caravans crossing deserts and mountains along the Silk Road, trading goods and ideas between East and West.

title: Les Mystères de la Science
author: Dr. Pierre Martin
overview: A curious young scientist and her classmates set out to uncover the mysteries of the natural world, from the smallest cells to the vast universe.

title: قصص التاريخ
author: أحمد بن يوسف
overview: Stories of the great turning points, civilisations and heroes that shaped the world and Morocco's rich history.

title: Le Petit Nicolas
author: René Goscinny
overview: The hilarious everyday adventures of a schoolboy and his friends in Paris, told with warmth and mischief. A favourite first chapter book for French readers.
